pr_body:
Previously, this test paused and resumed the producer job, which was unecessary and caused the test to flake. This patch removes that pause/resume sequence.

Fixes #114704

Release note: none
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/114985)

comments:
This test seems inherently flaky. After the initial scan completes, it temporarily pauses the producer job and assumes the ingestion job will stay alive, but that assumption is incorrrect. According to the logs:
```
W231119 09:02:13.896009 49179 ccl/streamingccl/streamingest/stream_ingestion_job.go:91 ⋮ [T1,Vsystem,n1,job=‹REPLICATION STREAM INGESTION id=918533343287312385›] 623  ingestion job failed (failed to resume ingestion job 918533343287312385 as the producer job 918533343572426753 is not active and in status ‹STREAM_PAUSED›) but is being paused
```
Given the naive assumption, the test assumes the hwm will advance later in the test, which it can't, because the ingestion job is paused.
